title: COMP Look Page
summary: Official Derivative common Look page for Panel COMP background color, Background TOP fill and smoothness, border colors, disabled colors, RGB-alpha multiplication, composite mode, and opacity.
guidance: Use this article when a Panel COMP needs a Background TOP, border styling, disabled-state color, compositing, or opacity behavior.
Old files may load TOP Smoothness as Mipmap Pixels, while new Panel COMPs default to Interpolate Pixels.
When the Background TOP input is 32-bit float format, nearest filtering is used regardless of the selected TOP Smoothness option.
Use the Composite parameter to control how a panel is composited with sibling panels; it follows Composite TOP-style operation names.
Use opacity for lightweight visual hiding when interaction and layout state should remain stable.
